description:
Event Bookings ships three ready-made alerts: a reminder 3 days before an event, another 1 day before, and an under-staffed warning.

Open the Notification list to review recipients, tweak the wording, or disable any you do not want. This is where **all** event alerts are configured — the app has no settings page of its own. For WhatsApp, create a **WhatsApp Notification** instead.
name: Review Event Notifications
title: Review your Event Alerts
